In many cultures, there are superstitions about cleaning on New Year's Day. Specifically, it is often believed that cleaning on New Year's Day can sweep away good luck and fortune for the coming year. This is why some people avoid cleaning on that day to not "sweep out" the good luck.

Option A says nothing happens, which contradicts the superstition.  
Option B says you will be unlucky, which is a possible interpretation but less specific.  
Option C says you will be lucky, which is generally not the belief.  
Option D says you will sweep out all of the good luck, which aligns with the common superstition.

Therefore, the best answer is D.

Answer: D
